newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Handlowy sees 1997 net up to PLN 568.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Polish Handlowy sees 1997 net up to PLN 568.3 mln.

text.p: Polish Bank Handlowy SA, slated for sale in late May, expects its 1997 net profit to rise to 568.3 million zlotys from 530.4 million in 1996, the bank said in its issue prospectus on Monday.
The bank said its pre-tax profit was likely to rise to 767.7 million zlotys this year from 747 million last year.
It said its profit from banking operations was seen at 1.2 billion zlotys, against 1.1 billion last year.
Revenues from interest were likely to rise to 769.1 million zlotys from 669.7 million in 1996, the bank said.
